templates.name: Lijsten
templates.code:
# Lijsten in Python
fruit = ["appel", "banaan", "kers", "druif"]

print("Alle fruit:")
for f in fruit:
    print(f"  - {f}")

print(f"\nAantal: {len(fruit)}")
print(f"Eerste: {fruit[0]}")
print(f"Laatste: {fruit[-1]}")

fruit.append("mango")
print(f"\nNa toevoegen: {fruit}")

# Dictionary in Python
leerling = {
    "naam": "Emma",
    "klas": "6A",
    "vakken": ["Python", "Wiskunde", "Nederlands"],
    "gemiddelde": 78.5
}

print(f"Naam: {leerling['naam']}")
print(f"Klas: {leerling['klas']}")
print(f"Gemiddelde: {leerling['gemiddelde']}")
print("Vakken:")
for vak in leerling["vakken"]:
    print(f"  - {vak}")
